items.desc_now: dsh-a2a-server makes a DeepSeek Harness agent reachable over the A2A (Agent2Agent) protocol. It serves an Agent Card at a well-known URI and implements the v0.3.0 JSON-RPC binding, so any compliant peer that knows the deployment's URL can discover the agent and submit tasks to it.
